article_title: 'I didn't speak the Queen's English': Why people worry about their accents

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly examining?
options: Why all regional accents are disappearing from Britain
How workplace accent bias can affect confidence, judgement and career opportunities
How actors learn foreign languages for television roles
Why employers now require staff to speak several languages
tasks.correct_answer: How workplace accent bias can affect confidence, judgement and career opportunities
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת כיצד הטיה כלפי מבטאים במקום העבודה משפיעה על ביטחון עצמי, על האופן שבו שופטים אנשים ועל הזדמנויות מקצועיות.

tasks.prompt: According to the survey, what did nearly one in five respondents believe?
options: Their accent had held them back in their career
Their workplace had banned regional vocabulary
Their colleagues could not understand any English
Their accent guaranteed them a promotion
tasks.correct_answer: Their accent had held them back in their career
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כמעט חמישית מן המשיבים חשבו שהמבטא שלהם עיכב את התקדמותם המקצועית.

tasks.prompt: What did about one in three people think others did because of their accent?
options: Offered them free language lessons
Moved them to another region
Made assumptions about their character or ability
Asked them to become public speakers
tasks.correct_answer: Made assumptions about their character or ability
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כשליש סברו שאנשים מסיקים מסקנות על אופיים או יכולתם רק על סמך המבטא.

tasks.prompt: Why might some workers soften or adapt their accent?
options: To hide that they know another language
To prepare for a singing competition
To make every regional accent sound identical
To avoid negative judgements and sound more accepted in professional settings
tasks.correct_answer: To avoid negative judgements and sound more accepted in professional settings
tasks.explanation_hebrew: עובדים עשויים לרכך או להתאים את מבטאם כדי להימנע משיפוט שלילי ולהיתפס כמקצועיים או מקובלים יותר.

tasks.prompt: What does “self-conscious” mean in the article’s discussion of professional settings?
options: Proud of speaking louder than everyone else
Uncomfortably aware of how one sounds to other people
Unable to recognise a familiar voice
Interested only in written communication
tasks.correct_answer: Uncomfortably aware of how one sounds to other people
tasks.explanation_hebrew: self-conscious פירושו מודע לעצמך באופן לא נוח או נבוך, כאן בנוגע לאופן שבו המבטא נשמע לאחרים.

tasks.prompt: If employers “scrutinise” recruitment and promotion decisions for accent bias, what do they do?
options: Examine the decisions very carefully
Cancel every promotion automatically
Replace interviews with spelling tests
Ignore the way candidates are assessed
tasks.explanation_hebrew: scrutinise פירושו לבדוק בקפידה רבה. בהקשר זה מדובר בבחינה מדוקדקת של החלטות גיוס וקידום כדי לזהות הטיה.

tasks.prompt: Give two ways accent bias can affect people at work.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתי השפעות שונות המתוארות בכתבה ולנסח אותן במילים של הלומד.
expected_points: People may feel anxious or self-conscious when speaking
Others may make assumptions about intelligence, character or capability
An accent may be seen as a barrier to recruitment or promotion
Some workers may change or soften their accent
Critical comments or imitation can make people feel excluded

tasks.prompt: Why is judging a person’s ability by their accent unfair?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את ההסקה ולהבחין בין צורת הדיבור לבין הכישורים או התוכן של דברי האדם.
expected_points: An accent reflects region, background or identity rather than ability
Different accents do not show how intelligent or capable a person is
Bias can disadvantage qualified candidates
Employers should assess evidence, experience and the content of answers

tasks.prompt: Summarise the article’s argument about accents and the workplace.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח סיכום מאוזן באנגלית הכולל את הבעיה, השפעותיה ודרך אפשרית להתמודד עמה.
expected_points: Accent bias remains present in some workplaces
Survey respondents reported anxiety and possible career disadvantages
People may be judged by assumptions unrelated to their actual ability
Some adapt their speech to fit professional expectations
Employers can review recruitment and promotion practices and focus on capability

tasks.prompt: Write a short recommendation to an employer on reducing accent prejudice. Support it with two ideas from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב המלצה מעשית וברורה באנגלית ולהשתמש בשתי נקודות המבוססות על הכתבה.
expected_points: Train interviewers to recognise accent bias
Use consistent criteria based on skills and experience
Review recruitment and promotion outcomes
Do not treat one accent as a sign of greater intelligence or professionalism
Challenge mocking, imitation or critical comments
Create an environment where regional identities are respected
